biological_reference.closest_mechanism: hippocampal-prefrontal constructive simulation of alternative futures (episodic future thinking): endpoints of imagined action sequences must be discriminable across options AND faithful to world structure
dependencies: a trained world/transition model with an action channel (ITEM 1)
reconstruction / accuracy pressure anchoring imagined content to real structure (episodic memory)
depth-scaling machinery (Addis & Schacter 2008: recruitment scales with remoteness)
biological_reference.divergence: InfoNCE endpoint discrimination is a pure classification pressure with no accuracy term that survives a confident K-way ordering; biology's simulation is generative-and-anchored. The measured signature (shrunk, under-dispersed endpoints at h=1; over-dispersed at depth on 4/6 seeds; goal-readout variance reached only at depth on one seed) is divergence detached from fidelity, the inverse of ITEM 2's collapse. Load-bearing for the next build: divergence and accuracy must be trained jointly, not sequentially.

live_hypotheses: H-fidelity-anchor (LEAD): the RSD endpoints have a shrunk centroid (norm 0.54-0.81 vs 1.41-2.17 same-start incumbents) and are under-dispersed at h=1 (0.33-0.62x real spread) because InfoNCE carries no accuracy term that survives a confident K-way ordering; a fidelity-anchored divergence objective (ITEM 3 + an endpoint-accuracy term) restores the centroid to the real band with real-scale spread, and the goal-proximity variance follows.

H-readout-saturation (MEASURE): the 0.002 var bar, through the bounded 1/(1+||z-z_goal||^2) readout, may demand ~3-4x over-dispersion relative to real spread -- it is reached in this run only by seed2024 at h=10/20/30 at spread 1.25-1.55 vs real 0.42-0.46. Real-endpoint goal_proximity variance has never been recorded (108b: means only). If real endpoints' own variance is < 0.002, the bar as registered is an instrument target to re-register, not a substrate target.

H-goal-orthogonal-dispersion (REPRESENTATION): the dispersion RSD induces projects weakly onto the goal axis (var/spread^2 5e-05..9e-04 at h=1, below most incumbent cells -- a fragile ratio, retained as basis only), so a goal-blind objective moves the readout only by brute over-dispersion (the seed2024 depth cells); a goal-axis-aware objective or a full-endpoint readout is needed at real spread.

RECORD goal_proximity variance AND goal_distance variance over the 40 REAL endpoint samples per horizon (Phase 4b already collects the samples), per seed, alongside the rollout values; also each arm's endpoint mean goal_distance and spread ratio vs real per horizon. project each arm's endpoint deviations (endpoint - centroid) onto the unit goal axis (z_goal - centroid) and report the fraction of spread variance along it, for real endpoints and each arm. learning_extracted: A 'lifts' label composed from a conjunctive absolute bar hides a cleared bar; separate the bars in the label rule when one clears by an order of magnitude and the other misses by three -- and read both bars at every horizon, not only h=1, or a depth cell that clears both (seed2024 h>=10) is invisible to every criterion.

PASS assigned unconditionally on readiness plus a fail-able load_bearing:true criterion is a guaranteed vacuous_pass (980's learning, repeated); tag classifying criteria load_bearing:false or declare criteria_aggregation, and let interpretation.label carry the outcome.

A contrastive endpoint objective with squared-L2 logits and no accuracy term that survives a confident ordering is satisfied by shrunk predictions: at h=1 the centroid collapses to 0.3-0.5x the incumbents' norm while spread stays below real; at depth the same objective over-disperses on 4/6 seeds. Divergence detached from fidelity, the inverse of ITEM 2's collapse. Train divergence and fidelity jointly.

cr_ratio = spread / centroid_norm is scale-free by design and cannot see a shrunk centroid: dividing the same spread by the real centroid norm turns 0.77-1.81 into 0.08-0.17. The bar clear survives that correction on 4/6 seeds, but report the corrected figure beside the raw one whenever the objective is not accuracy-anchored, and pair the ratio with a centroid-norm band.

resolution_patch.basis: V3-EXQ-1000 (2026-09-03) CONFIRMED this leg: its declared null ('a contrastive-trained ON arm within the 3.0 paired-lift band of a depth-0 single-step incumbent at h=1 AND with depth growth no larger than the incumbent's, n>=6') is rejected on the first clause by 1-3 orders of magnitude -- ARM_RSD cr_ratio(h=1) lift over ARM_OFF 693/1838/56/88/1457/2714 on seeds 42/123/7/2024/17/31 (6/6 >= 3.0, sign p=0.0156), absolute 0.771-1.81 clearing the 0.1 bar 6/6 by 7.7x-18x, the statistic this question's title names. Control passed (8/8 readiness incl. rsd_objective_engaged 100% and action-sensitivity ratio 1.32-1.52 vs floor 1.05, grad steps matched gap 0), non_degenerate true. The second clause (depth growth) is moot: RSD sits at cr_ratio ~1 from h=1 so its multiplicative growth (0.83-2.68) is below OFF's (2.5-5.5) while its absolute h=5 values (0.64-4.41) exceed OFF's (0.002-0.10) by 22x-2070x. The lift is real at the spread level (RSD 0.15-0.24 vs OFF 2e-04..8e-03), not only in the ratio; the ratio is inflated by a centroid shrink (norm 0.54-0.81 vs incumbents 1.41-2.17) and the centroid-corrected h=1 ratio 0.115/0.081/0.080/0.167/0.138/0.103 still clears 0.1 on 4/6 seeds. What this run does NOT settle: the goal-proximity readout (e1coe_score_var, 36x-1700x short) -- a different statistic, registered as the new question sd_e1_var_bar_readout_crush. Adjudicated by failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-1000_2026-09-04.

hypotheses.label: shrunk centroid and under-dispersed h=1 endpoints: InfoNCE carries no surviving accuracy term
hypotheses.desc: RSD endpoints sit at centroid_norm 0.54-0.81 vs 1.41-2.17 for the same-start incumbents and are 0.33-0.62x real spread at h=1; the goal-proximity readout is flat there. A fidelity-anchored divergence objective (ITEM 3 InfoNCE + an endpoint-accuracy term) restores the centroid to the real band with real-scale spread and the readout variance follows.
hypotheses.basis: V3-EXQ-1000 cells: centroid-norm shrink; spread 0.33-0.62x real at h=1; both bars reached only at h>=10 on seed2024 at 3-3.7x real spread. Declared null: ARM_RSD+anchor's centroid_norm stays outside the real band on a majority of seeds at h=1 OR its e1coe_score_var(h=1) is within 2x of ARM_RSD's.

hypotheses.label: the 0.002 var bar, through the bounded 1/(1+d^2) readout, demands over-dispersion relative to real spread
hypotheses.desc: goal_proximity is bounded and flat for goal-distant states; in V3-EXQ-1000 the bar is reached only at spread 3-3.7x real (seed2024 h=10/20/30). The lineage never measured the readout's variance over its own REAL endpoint samples (108b: means 0.64-0.81 only). If real endpoints' variance is < 0.002, the bar is an instrument target to re-register, not a substrate target.
hypotheses.basis: Recording gap identified by failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-1000_2026-09-04: Phase 4b collects 40 real endpoints per horizon and writes only their contrast ratio. Declared null: real-endpoint goal_proximity variance >= 0.002 on a majority of seeds.

hypotheses.label: RSD's divergence lies in a subspace nearly orthogonal to the goal axis
hypotheses.desc: Even on-manifold, the induced endpoint dispersion does not project onto (z_goal - centroid); a goal-blind objective cannot move a goal-projected readout.
hypotheses.basis: V3-EXQ-1000: var/spread^2 for ARM_RSD 5e-05..9e-04 at h=1, below most (15/18) incumbent cells -- a fragile ratio of near-zero quantities, confounded with the readout slope at the centroid's goal distance (red-team F3); retained as basis only. Declared null: ARM_RSD's goal-axis fraction of spread variance is within 2x of the real endpoints'.
